senses.definition: a hostile meeting of opposing military forces in the course of a war

latin_glosses: Dominus docet manus meas ad prælium, et digitos meos ad bellum
attestations: Exon. 102b; Th. 389, 3; Rä. 7, 2: Andr. Kmbl. 468; An. 234

quotations.english: Christ has placed me in battle
quotations.citations: Exon. 102b; Th. 389, 3; Rä. 7, 2: Andr. Kmbl. 468; An. 234

quotations.english: he overcame the liberty of enemies in battle
